:::{#thm-outer-product-matvec}
#### An outer product times a vector

For a vector $\vecf{u}$ with $m$ entries
and two vectors $\vecf{v}$ and $\vecf{w}$ with $n$ entries,
the [product](linear-algebra.qmd#def-matvec-mult)
of the [outer product](#def-outer-product) $\oprod{\vecf{u}}{\vecf{v}}$
with $\vecf{w}$
[equals](linear-algebra.qmd#def-matrix-equality) the [scalar multiple](linear-algebra.qmd#def-scalar-mult) of $\vecf{u}$
by the [dot product](linear-algebra.qmd#def-dot-product) $\tprod{\vecf{v}}{\vecf{w}}$:

$$
\underbrace{\paren{\oprod{\vecf{u}}{\vecf{v}}} \vecf{w}}_{m \times 1}
= \paren{\tprod{\vecf{v}}{\vecf{w}}} \underbrace{\vecf{u}}_{m \times 1}
$$

:::

::: proof

Entry $i$ of each side, for $i$ from $1$ to $m$:

$$
\ba
\sb{\paren{\oprod{\vecf{u}}{\vecf{v}}} \vecf{w}}_{i}
&= \sumto{j}{n} \paren{\oprod{\vecf{u}}{\vecf{v}}}_{ij} w_j
&& \text{(definition of matrix-vector multiplication)}
\\
&= \sumto{j}{n} u_i v_j w_j
&& \text{(entries of an outer product)}
\\
&= u_i \sumto{j}{n} v_j w_j
&& \text{(factor } u_i \text{ out of the sum)}
\\
&= u_i \paren{\tprod{\vecf{v}}{\vecf{w}}}
&& \text{(definition of the dot product)}
\\
&= \paren{\tprod{\vecf{v}}{\vecf{w}}} u_i
&& \text{(multiplication of numbers is commutative)}
\\
&= \sb{\paren{\tprod{\vecf{v}}{\vecf{w}}} \vecf{u}}_{i}
&& \text{(definition of scalar multiplication)}
\ea
$$

:::
